Dreaming is opt-in by directory. Only sessions run in a scoped directory,
or below one, are reviewed, with the memory directories, commits and
handoff docs that go with them. The friction box is the host's whatever
the scope: it is about agent itself. With nothing in scope, gather finds
nothing and run starts nothing.

  add <dir>      add a directory (made absolute from here)
  remove <dir>   remove one
  list           list them

The scope is kept in this host's store (host state dream.scope).

Usage:
  agent dream scope [flags]
  agent dream scope [command]

Examples:
  agent dream scope add ~/src/app
  agent dream scope list
  agent dream scope remove ~/src/app

Available Commands:
  add         Add a directory to the dream scope
  remove      Remove a directory from the dream scope
  list        List the directories in the dream scope

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for scope

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent dream scope [command] --help" for more information about a command.
